title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #16

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water needed by all living things? (1 mark)
   A. It makes things noisy
   B. It is always warm
   C. Life cannot continue without it
   D. It hides the sun

2. Which is a good way to save water? (1 mark)
   A. Close the tap fully after use
   B. Pour water on the road
   C. Wash the car every day
   D. Leave taps running

3. Which element do we breathe in? (1 mark)
   A. Prithvi
   B. Agni
   C. Vayu
   D. Jal

4. Why is it a mistake to say there are four elements in the Panch Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. There is only one
   B. There are seven
   C. There are five
   D. There are ten

5. In a maize farm, what does the sun's heat that ripens the crop represent among the elements? (1 mark)
   A. Prithvi
   B. Akash
   C. Agni
   D. Jal

6. Which element is called Prithvi? (1 mark)
   A. Earth
   B. Air
   C. Water
   D. Fire

7. What did Siddhartha later become? (1 mark)
   A. A Jain Tirthankar
   B. The Buddha, the Awakened One
   C. A Sikh Guru
   D. An Avtar of Vishnu

8. What does the word Enlightened mean in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Very rich
   B. Very loud
   C. Very tall
   D. Full of the light of true knowledge

9. What does the story of the swan teach us? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore suffering
   B. To be proud
   C. To be kind to animals and help the hurt
   D. To hunt for fun

10. What are the Laavan? (1 mark)
   A. Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   B. Yoga postures
   C. Festival songs of Maha Shivratri
   D. Prayers before meals

11. How many directions (groups of people) does the Sigalovada Sutta list? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Four
   C. Two
   D. Nine

12. What do Sikhs eat together in the gurdwara? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting food
   B. Langar, the community meal
   C. Nothing
   D. Prasad only from a priest

13. Which faith does the Dhammapada belong to? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Buddhism

14. How should you dress to visit a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Wearing school uniform
   B. Very informally
   C. Modestly
   D. Wearing a heavy coat

15. What is the garbhagriha? (1 mark)
   A. The inner room where the murti is placed
   B. The kitchen
   C. The gate
   D. The car park

16. Which words begin the well-known Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   D. Twameva mata cha pita twameva

17. What does the book stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Food
   B. Fire
   C. Rain
   D. Knowledge

18. What is a common mistake about lies? (1 mark)
   A. Owning up
   B. Thinking honesty is important
   C. Thinking small lies do not matter
   D. Returning items

19. Which action during the journey is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Putting hands out of the window
   B. Keeping the aisle clear
   C. Sitting still
   D. Speaking quietly

20. What is the correct way to sit for Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Slouching
   B. Lying on the stomach
   C. With a straight back and relaxed body
   D. Standing on one leg

21. Which is an activity for International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. Skipping class
   B. Doing yoga together at school or a park
   C. Playing loud music
   D. Staying at home only

22. What should you do if you feel dizzy during yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Continue faster
   B. Ignore it
   C. Stop at once
   D. Hold your breath

23. How many Purusharthas are there? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Ten
   C. Two
   D. Four

24. Which of these is a way of following Artha? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing
   B. Cheating
   C. Wasting food
   D. Saving pocket money and not taking what is not yours

25. Which festival comes last of the three studied? (1 mark)
   A. Yoga Day
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Maha Shivratri
   D. Paryushan Parva

26. What does charity work at festivals help with? (1 mark)
   A. Buying more sweets for ourselves
   B. Wasting food
   C. Sharing with those who cannot afford food or clothes
   D. Making noise

27. What is the first line of the Kenyan National Anthem? (1 mark)
   A. Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   B. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara
   D. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah

28. Which is a memory trick for the seven names? (1 mark)
   A. Writing them once
   B. Reading backwards only
   C. Making a rhyme or song
   D. Skipping them

29. What is the Indian name for Saturday? (1 mark)
   A. Guruvaar
   B. Ravivaar
   C. Mangalvaar
   D. Shanivaar

30. Shukra is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Saturn
   C. Mercury
   D. Mars

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe how to pray well. (4 marks)

32. Choose one teaching from an Enlightened Being and say how you can follow it at school. (3 marks)

33. Name the four Enlightened Beings studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

34. Write the Indian names for Tuesday and Wednesday. (2 marks)

35. What is a festival? (2 marks)

36. Compare Vajra Asana and Sasankasana. (5 marks)

37. Explain how a school can make festivals inclusive. (4 marks)

38. What is integrity? (2 marks)

39. Write the seven days of the week in the Indian traditional calendar with their heavenly bodies. (4 marks)

40. Suggest four activities for celebrating International Yoga Day in school. (4 marks)

41. Describe what the Panchang is. (2 marks)

42. What does the name Narsimha mean? (2 marks)

43. Draw a timeline from January to December and mark Maha Shivratri, Madaraka Day and Paryushan. (4 marks)

44. State three rules of good behaviour when visiting a Mandir. (3 marks)

45. Name two grahas in the traditional calendar that are not planets in modern science. (2 marks)

46. Who compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji first, and who declared it the eternal Guru? (2 marks)

47. Explain why water is important in our daily lives. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Life cannot continue without it
   People, animals and plants all need water to live.

2. A — Close the tap fully after use
   Closing taps stops waste.

3. C — Vayu
   Air is Vayu.

4. C — There are five
   Panch means five.

5. C — Agni
   Heat and light belong to Agni.

6. A — Earth
   Prithvi is the Sanskrit word for earth, the soil and rocks.

7. B — The Buddha, the Awakened One
   Siddhartha became the Buddha.

8. D — Full of the light of true knowledge
   Enlightened beings are wise and full of true knowledge.

9. C — To be kind to animals and help the hurt
   Siddhartha showed kindness.

10. A — Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   Guru Ram Das Ji wrote these wedding hymns.

11. A — Six
   It lists six groups.

12. B — Langar, the community meal
   Everyone eats together in the langar.

13. D — Buddhism
   It is a collection of Buddhist verses.

14. C — Modestly
   Modest dress shows respect.

15. A — The inner room where the murti is placed
   It is the inner sanctum.

16. C — Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   This is the opening line.

17. D — Knowledge
   The book stands for knowledge.

18. C — Thinking small lies do not matter
   Small lies grow.

19. A — Putting hands out of the window
   Hands can be hurt.

20. C — With a straight back and relaxed body
   A straight back helps breathing.

21. B — Doing yoga together at school or a park
   People do yoga together.

22. C — Stop at once
   Stop and rest.

23. D — Four
   There are four.

24. D — Saving pocket money and not taking what is not yours
   Artha is honest wealth.

25. D — Paryushan Parva
   It occurs in August or September.

26. C — Sharing with those who cannot afford food or clothes
   We share with the needy.

27. A — Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   The anthem is Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu.

28. C — Making a rhyme or song
   Songs help us remember.

29. D — Shanivaar
   Shani is Saturn.

30. A — Venus
   Shukra is Venus.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly, fold hands, think of God with love, say thanks, ask for wisdom and kindness, and end with a promise to do good (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any sensible answer, for example Ahimsa: I will not bully or hurt classmates, and I will care for plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the being, 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for a clear action.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha, Parshvanath, Buddha (Prince Siddhartha) and Sri Guru Ram Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tuesday: Mangalvaar. Wednesday: Budhvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: A special day or set of days when people come together to remember something important.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for special day and 1 mark for remembering or celebrating together.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Vajra Asana is sitting on the heels with a straight back. Sasankasana starts in Vajra Asana and bends forward with the forehead on the mat and arms stretched forward. Both are calm and use steady breathing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each pose and 1 mark for a similarity.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Give clear instructions, help learners with special needs to take part, share food and clothes with the needy, and invite all faiths and communities.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Being honest and doing what is right even when nobody is watching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honesty and 1 mark for doing right when unseen.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ravivaar: Sun; Somvaar: Moon; Mangalvaar: Mars; Budhvaar: Mercury; Guruvaar: Jupiter; Shukravaar: Venus; Shanivaar: Saturn.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for every two correct pairs, up to 4.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Doing yoga together, taking photos or videos, making a chart of asanas, making a guidance video with an adult (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Indian traditional calendar book that lists days, months and festival dates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for two points.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Man-lion, from nar (man) and simha (lion).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: A line from January to December with Maha Shivratri in February or March, Madaraka Day on 1 June and Paryushan in August or September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the line and months, 1 mark for each correct festival.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, switch off phones, do not touch the murti, ask before taking photographs (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Sun and the Moon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Arjan Dev Ji compiled it; Guru Gobind Singh Ji declared it the Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Water is needed for drinking and cooking, for washing and cleaning, and for growing crops and giving drinks to animals. Without it people, animals and plants cannot live.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three correct points.
